title: Isolated monitoring read workload

deadline_seconds.description: Whole authenticated read workload deadline in seconds; default30.

request_seconds.description: Each actual HTTP client deadline in seconds, <=whole deadline; default5.

fault_milliseconds.description: Owned actual SQL-lock request timeout in milliseconds, <request_seconds*1000; default100. Lock release/join and a fresh real snapshot measure recovery.

maximum_body_bytes.description: Per-response complete decode ceiling in bytes; default1048576; truncation is failure.

maximum_errors.description: Explicit allowed error ceiling, <total requests; default0. No error converted to success.

stop_on_error.description: True cancels admission on first observed failure; false is literal false, still bounded by maximum_errors/deadline.

stages.description: Sequential stages; requests>=concurrency; total<=2000. Default stages1x3 then2x6. No external target field.

description: Nonsecret exact JSON selected CLI --workload-configuration > exact --workload-env-file > tracked capacity.json. All fields required. Go/Python enforce cross-field ranges. Parent owns resource admission/SQL/services/retained evidence. No customer endpoint/process PID.
